packageRules.description: CAD's container image lives at build/Dockerfile, not boilerplate's config/Dockerfile, so we re-scope the dockerfile manager (above) to build/Dockerfile. Boilerplate ignores its own builder image because it only scans config/; re-add that ignore here now that build/ is in scope. The boilerplate builder uses the rolling :latest tag (not digest-pinned), so every image build fetches the current image on its own - there is nothing for Renovate to bump, and pinning it would defeat the automatic CVE/Go-toolchain refresh.

build/Dockerfile base image (ubi) updates. Add area/dependency + ok-to-test so MintMaker PRs get Prow presubmits; boilerplate adds lgtm/approved for dockerfile minor/patch/pin/digest. Update cadence is left to MintMaker's global minimumReleaseAge, matching other boilerplate consumers. TODO(upstream): boilerplate only auto-applies ok-to-test to major updates; once we have confirmed this reliably triggers presubmits on MintMaker minor/patch PRs, propose moving ok-to-test into boilerplate's dockerfile rule so every consumer benefits and this override can be dropped.

Add area/dependency + ok-to-test so MintMaker gomod PRs get Prow presubmits; boilerplate handles grouping, scheduling, and lgtm/approved.
